hook: Food truck owners: 3 questions before *winter* menus
title: Food truck *paperwork* quiz

questions.q: You got your health permit last year. Good forever?
questions.why: Most permits renew on a schedule. Check the date on yours.

questions.q: Besides the permit, what else on the truck can expire?
questions.why: The truck, the kitchen and the business all have their own dates.

questions.q: The holiday market wants your insurance certificate. Is the one from spring OK?
questions.why: Event organizers often require a current certificate.

payoff: How many did you get? Comment your score.

cta.title: Know every date before the market does.
cta.body: CertTrack tracks expiration dates and alerts you before they expire.
